cards.card_text: Then Jesus drops a quick one, short and sharp: "Do not give dogs what is holy; do not throw your pearls before swine."
cards.verse_text: Do not give dogs what is holy; do not throw your pearls before swine.
cards.snippet: Do not give dogs what is holy; do not throw your pearls before swine.

cards.card_text: Jesus warns against throwing your pearls before swine.
cards.verse_text: Do not give dogs what is holy; do not throw your pearls before swine.
cards.snippet: Do not give dogs what is holy; do not throw your pearls before swine.

cards.card_text: Again, Jesus says the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant in search of fine pearls.
cards.verse_text: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant in search of fine pearls.
cards.snippet: …the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant in search of fine pearls.

cards.card_text: The merchant finds one very precious pearl.
cards.verse_text: When he found one very precious pearl, he went away and sold all he had and bought it.
cards.snippet: When he found one very precious pearl, he went away and sold all he had and bought it.

cards.card_text: He wants them to dress respectably, with modesty and self-control, not with braided hair or gold or pearls or expensive clothes.
cards.verse_text: Likewise, I want the women to adorn themselves with respectable apparel, with modesty, and with self-control, not with braided hair or gold or pearls or expensive clothes,
cards.snippet: …with modesty, and with self-control, not with braided hair or gold or pearls or expensive clothes,

cards.card_text: The woman on the scarlet beast is adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls.
cards.verse_text: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls.
cards.snippet: …in purple and scarlet, and adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls.

cards.card_text: The city is pure gold, the wall is jasper, the foundations are adorned with every kind of precious stone, and each of the twelve gates is one single pearl.
cards.verse_text: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls, with each gate consisting of a single pearl.
cards.snippet: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls, with each gate consisting of a single pearl.
